text.p: A Chantal Pharmaceutical Corp shareholder filed a motion Wednesday in Delaware Chancery Court to compel Chantal to hold a shareholder meeting next week in California instead of New York.

Chantal has scheduled a shareholder meeting for June 17 in New York, according to John Newcomer, the attorney for the shareholder. The company called the meeting after the shareholder sued Chantal in Delaware for violating its bylaws, which require meetings to be held annually.
Separately, a group of dissident shareholders are seeking to oust Chantal's chief executive and board of directors.

The shareholder group, led by investor Peter Ting, filed a document with the Securities and Exchange Commission Tuesday relating to its intention to oust the company's chief executive officer Chantal Burnison and her board of directors.
A spokesperson for Chantal was not available. On Monday, Chantal named actress and former cosmetics firm owner Polly Bergen as chief operating officer and one of five new directors.
